## Key Insights

1. Kharif Sowing Status: Kharif sowing data collection has started from 06th June, 2025 and the sowing is in preliminary stage. As on 27 June, 2025, the area sown under Kharif crops is 262.15 lakh ha (including 55.16 lakh ha (105% of normal area) in Sugarcane) as compared to 235.44 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. (The normal area coverage during Kharif is estimated to be more than 1100 lakh ha.)

## 2. Weather Update :

- a) Temperature: Maximum temperatures are likely to be below normal by 2-4°C over most parts of the country except northeast India, where it is likely to be above normal by 2- 3°C.
- b) Rainfall Distribution: From June 01- 29 June, 2025, the All-India cumulative rainfall is 9% higher than its Long Period Average (LPA), with regional variations: (i) East & Northeast India:(-)17%; (ii) Northwest India: 42%; (iii) Central India: 25%; and South Peninsula:(-) 3%.

Heavy to very heavy rainfall activity likely to continue over many parts of Northwest, Central, East & Northeast India during next 7 days, with isolated extremely heavy falls over Jharkhand on 29th & 30th and Odisha on 29th June.

Scattered to fairly widespread rainfall very likely over central India, ghat area of western coast, eastern India & northwest India.

Isolated to scattered rainfall very likely over the south peninsula India & western India.

Rainfall along with thunderstorm & gusty wind likely over northwest India till next 3-4 days.

Overall, above normal rainfall along with central and east and northwest India and; below normal over southern peninsula and northeast parts of India during the week.

## Inputs Situation

- a) Water Reservoir Status : As on 26th June 2025, the total live water storage in 161 important reservoirs across the country (monitored by CWC) is 66.45 Billion Cubic Meter, which is 36.4% of total live storage capacity (182.44 BCM). The current year's storage is nearly 176 percent of last year's storage and 153 percent of the average storage of the last ten years during the corresponding period. The overall storage position is better than the corresponding period of last year in the country as a whole and is also better than the Normal storage during the corresponding period.
